items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: he was later with Cab Callaway

ctx.x: You started as an arranger, didn't you? No, I started, I started playing violin. I was with this man playing violin. Well, I mean with your writing though, you started with the banjo. Uh-huh.

And, uh, the banjo became so prominent, prominent that I got a banjo. And, uh, then I went to the Regal Theater in 1929 and we had a wonderful band there. We had Red Top playing trumpet and he was later with Cab Callaway, he was playing a tremendous trumpet.
